title: Relation between Hitting Times and Probabilities for Imprecise Markov Chains
summary: In the present paper, we investigate the relationship between hitting times and hitting probabilities in discrete-time imprecise Markov chains (IMCs). We define lower and upper hitting times and probabilities for IMCs whose set of transition matrices $\T$ is compact, convex, and has separately specified rows.
